title: A Glowing Ocean the Size of Iceland Was Seen From Space

scenes.text: An ocean glowed so brightly that satellites saw it from space.
In 2019, south of Java, the sea glowed over about 100,000 square kilometres. That's roughly the size of Iceland.
Sailors call it a milky sea.
It isn't a wave or a wake. It's a steady glow that lasted about two weeks.
The light comes from glowing bacteria, packed at around 100 million per millilitre.
A sea of light so big, you can see it from space.
